title: Adaptive mixed prefill/decode token budget
problem: Mixed long-prefill/decode traffic may increase decode tail latency.
mechanism: Use live scheduler state to reduce the per-step token budget only when prefill and decode overlap under pressure.
expected_benefit: Lower decode tail latency under mixed traffic.

evidence.mechanism_note: M4 trace must show prompt tokens sharing scheduling steps with active decode requests when TPOT/ITL tail worsens.
evidence.correctness_plan: Greedy correctness probe response hashes and token counts must match between baseline and candidate.
evidence.upstream_overlap: vLLM 0.29 has static scheduler budget/chunking controls; re-audit confirms whether dynamic state-driven adaptation remains a meaningful gap.
